incidentLocation: Main St and Oak Ave intersection, Portland, OR
incidentDescription: Collision occurred at Main St and Oak Ave intersection. Claimant states she had green light, other driver ran red light. Passenger Emily Rodriguez transported to Portland General Hospital with neck and back pain.

policyContext.coverageType: Comprehensive Auto Insurance with Medical Coverage
relevantClauses: Section 4.2: Collision coverage applies when insured vehicle is struck by another vehicle
Section 5.1: Medical payments coverage up to $10,000 per person
Section 6.1: Rental car reimbursement up to $50/day for 30 days
Section 8.2: Liability coverage up to $100,000 per person for bodily injury
Section 10.1: Claims exceeding $20,000 require senior adjuster approval
ambiguityIndicators: Liability dispute - conflicting statements on traffic light status
Medical claim requires verification of injury causation and treatment necessity

blockerReason: Liability reconciliation pending and medical evaluation incomplete - requires senior adjuster approval per Section 10.1
lastAgentAction: Medical DW reviewed emergency room records, liability dispute flagged for senior review

narrativeSynthesis.description: Collision occurred at Main St and Oak Ave intersection
Claimant states she had green light, other driver ran red light
Other driver claims light was yellow when entering intersection
Passenger Emily Rodriguez transported to Portland General Hospital with neck and back pain
Both vehicles towed from scene due to significant damage
Claimant submitted FNOL via mobile app from hospital
Medical DW reviewed emergency room records, passenger diagnosed with whiplash and soft tissue injuries
Traffic camera footage requested from city, pending receipt

anomalySignals.description: Conflicting statements between claimant and other driver regarding traffic light status - requires traffic camera verification
anomalySignals.evidenceSource: Claimant Statement vs Other Driver Statement
anomalySignals.explanation: The claimant states she had a green light when entering the intersection, while the other driver claims the light was yellow. This fundamental disagreement on the traffic signal status creates liability uncertainty that must be resolved before settlement authorization. Traffic camera footage has been requested to provide objective evidence.

anomalySignals.description: Passenger injury claim with ongoing medical treatment - potential exposure exceeds $18,000 based on initial diagnosis
anomalySignals.explanation: The passenger sustained whiplash and soft tissue injuries requiring ongoing physical therapy and medical treatment. Initial emergency room visit, diagnostic imaging, and treatment plan indicate potential medical costs of $11,500-$18,000. Combined with pain and suffering claims, total medical exposure could significantly exceed standard settlement authority.

anomalySignals.description: Combined vehicle and medical damages estimated at $24,000 - exceeds standard adjuster authority per Section 10.1
anomalySignals.explanation: The combined estimated damages of $24,000 (vehicle repair $9,200 + medical $11,500 + rental/other $3,300) exceed the $20,000 threshold specified in Policy Section 10.1. This requires mandatory senior adjuster review and approval before any settlement can be authorized, regardless of liability determination.

evidenceItems.description: Official accident report with diagram, witness statements, and officer observations
12 photos showing damage to both vehicles and intersection
Emergency room records from Portland General Hospital
Detailed repair estimate for claimant vehicle
Request submitted to city for traffic camera footage
Active auto insurance policy with medical and collision coverage

recommendedAction.description: Escalate to senior adjuster for liability determination and settlement authority due to disputed liability, high medical exposure, and authority threshold
recommendedAction.rationale: Liability is disputed with conflicting traffic light statements. Medical exposure is significant with ongoing treatment. Combined damages of $24,000 exceed standard adjuster authority per Section 10.1. Traffic camera footage pending but required for liability determination. Senior review mandatory before settlement authorization.
recommendedAction.estimatedImpact: Settlement decision delayed 5-7 business days pending senior review and traffic camera footage. Potential total exposure $22,000-$28,000 including medical, vehicle repair, rental costs, and potential pain/suffering claim.
recommendedAction.claimantMessage: We are actively investigating your claim and have requested traffic camera footage to verify the sequence of events. A senior adjuster will contact you within 48 hours to discuss next steps. Your rental car has been authorized for up to 21 days while we complete our investigation.

breakdown.description: Emergency room visit, follow-up care, physical therapy, and ongoing treatment (estimated)
Lost wages, pain and suffering, legal consultation (estimated)

auditTrail.outcome: FNOL intake completed via mobile app
Coverage confirmed for collision and medical payments
Emergency room records reviewed, whiplash and soft tissue injuries confirmed
Repair estimate reviewed and validated at $9,200
Liability dispute identified - conflicting traffic light statements
Traffic camera footage requested from city
Case flagged for senior adjuster review due to liability dispute, high medical exposure, and authority threshold
